description: Part 2 case, KRW firms, one criterion (S-02). KRW's archived values of the race card (krw.race.card.*: sizes, N, s, E, DR, E/N, risk at tau = .20) and the lambda grid (krw.grid.race.*: grade sizes at every grid value) are case keys of numbers-cases.json; the race card's withheld pairs, its stated pairs whose error exceeds .20 and the lambda-tau conversion at .25 are keys of part1-l01.json and part2.json. This fragment adds postrank's evaluation of the fixed race card on the released race array at tau = .20 (E, DR as E/M, E/N, the error and withholding terms; evaluateReport; E, DR and E/N name the archived keys they match with same_as), its between-grade expected wrong shares and pair counts (betweenGradeErrors), two released firm values (Genuine Parts' SE and Nationwide's estimate, for the reasons of Tasks 1 and 4), and the two grid settings the page names, the first positive lambda (.01) and the first lambda with more than one grade (.08), each with its tau.

s02.race.card.note: KRW's published race card (sizes 2, 81, 14), grade 1 = largest white-name contact advantage

s02.race.card.tau20.note: evaluation of a fixed report: the race card at tau = .20 on the released race array (golden krwCard-race-lambda.25-tau.2 has its N, E, E/N and risk)

s02.race.meantop.note: row 61 (Genuine Parts (Napa Auto), the largest race posterior mean, sixth by estimate): its SE, as the mean of a one-state law

s02.race.est2.note: row 36 (Nationwide, the second largest race estimate and the largest in grade 2): its estimate, as the mean of a one-state law

s02.race.card.between.note: the stated pairs between each two grades and their mean error, in the order (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3)

s02.race.card.tau20.DR.note: KRW's discordance rate of the card as postrank evaluates it: E/M, the expected wrong directions over all M pairs (KRW's archived DR .0387 agrees at this precision)

s02.race.card.tau20.EoverN.note: E/N, the expected share of wrong directions among the N stated pairs (KRW's archived conditional DR .136 agrees at this precision)

s02.race.card.tau20.E.note: E, the expected wrong directions among the stated pairs, on the released array (180.0739; KRW's archived E 180.0734 agrees at the four significant digits shown)

s02.race.card.tau20.wh.note: the withholding term tau (M - N)/M of the card's risk at tau = .20

s02.race.card.tau20.s.pct.note: s = N/M of the card as a percentage, for the model report sentence

s02.race.card.tau20.EoverN.pct.note: E/N as a percentage of the stated directions, for the model report sentence

s02.race.card.tau20.DR.pct.note: DR = E/M as a percentage of all pairs, for the model report sentence

s02.race.card.between12.note: expected share of wrong stated directions between grades 1 and 2

s02.race.card.between13.note: expected share of wrong stated directions between grades 1 and 3

s02.race.card.between23.note: expected share of wrong stated directions between grades 2 and 3

s02.race.card.between12.pairs.note: stated pairs between grades 1 and 2 (2 x 81)

s02.race.card.between13.pairs.note: stated pairs between grades 1 and 3 (2 x 14)

s02.race.card.between23.pairs.note: stated pairs between grades 2 and 3 (81 x 14)

s02.race.meantop.se.note: Genuine Parts' race SE (.071), about half of AutoNation's (krw.race.esttop.se, .131): the narrower posterior that splits first along KRW's grid

s02.race.est2.estimate.note: Nationwide's race estimate (.402), the largest in grade 2 (krw.race.est2.grade): larger than Genuine Parts' .330 (grade 1), smaller than AutoNation's .433 (grade 1)
